items.reasons: The outline is light grey, not the originals' dark navy. It is drawn as a flat front elevation with only about 1–2 rows of top plane, so there is no lit top surface.
The top desk plane with a monitor is visible above a short emblem front panel, it has a dark outline and wood shading close to the wardrobe, and it sits on the floor at a believable size.

The desk and lamps are drawn near-plan-view while the divider posts and legs are shown in elevation, so the view is mixed. Heavy dark outlines box every part and make the lower half a muddy brown blob.
It has a clear lit wooden top plank several rows deep, a short front with three bays of colored book spines, wood shading that matches the wardrobe, and a solid base on the floor.
It reads as a top-down floor plan: the chair is seen from above and both blue side walls are shown as side faces. It is also about 1.5 tiles too tall for the room.
It is a flat white front elevation with almost no top plane. The outline is pale grey with stray tan corner dots instead of the dark outline the originals use.
It is a narrow flat-front stack of orange and blue bands with no readable basket openings seen from above. At 1x it reads as a striped column, not a basket stand.
The light grey outline and very thin top rail make it a front elevation. It lacks the dark outline weight of the originals.
The top is only a thin 1–2 row light band, so there is no readable lit counter or glass top plane. It looks like a framed front view of a cabinet.
It has a white top plane several rows deep, a red header band, two glass doors with stocked shelves, a dark base vent, and a dark outline consistent with mci-cooler and the counter.
The top is a thin white strip with a blue awning band and the rest is a flat open front. It lacks a lit top plane and depth for an open case.
The left and right silhouette edges are stair-stepped and jagged, and the pink sign block sits as a separate bit on top, so the outline looks broken and noisy.
It has a grey top plane about 3 rows deep, a dark outline, and evenly stocked can rows in muted colors that fit the cooler. Its size and floor placement are believable.
The saturated purple top and box blocks and the bright yellow boxes clash with the chipset's muted palette and read as sticker-like color fields.
The lower shelf is noisy with tiny bottles, and stray orange dots sit along the bottom rail. The top beam is a dark grey slab rather than a lit plane.
The whole unit is a muddy red-on-red mass with noisy orange and white specks. The body has no neutral structure or dark outline like the originals.
The outline is dark green instead of navy and the top plane is muddy green with blotchy packages. The lower boxes are noisy beige smudges.
It has a grey top plane, a dark outline, and clearly readable blue bottles and bottle packs on two shelves, with a palette and density matching the cooler. It sits correctly on the floor.
The side outlines are pale grey or missing instead of the originals' dark outline, and the top plane is only a thin white strip.
The glass top tray with meat cuts is seen from above, and the short white front with a red stripe matches mci-counter-register. It has a dark outline and a believable width on the floor.
